text:
Rory: Quick greenroom sync for the mini-webinar next week
Maya: thumbs up. agenda? keep it tight: 30-35m.
Ike: propose 5m intro, 18m demo playbook, 7m checklist + CTA, 5m Qs.
Dina: I'll host and do checklist. Ike you good for demo?
Ike: yes. will show baseline -> batching -> cache -> model route. will include p50/p95 + token cost per 1k.
Rory: need a 90s fallback video of the demo results. who records?
Ike: I will record the 90s fallback and a short CLI clip. will upload to drive.
Maya: rehearsal slots: Tue 09:00 PT tech check, Thu 16:00 PT full run. which works?
Dina: both work for me. book them.
GreenroomBot: Rehearsal created: Tue 09:00 PT (tech) and Thu 16:00 PT (full). Links sent.
Rory: landing page copy needed: 1-line hook, 2-sentence blurb, 3 TL;DR bullets, 2 CTA variants. Maya can you draft headlines?
Maya: will post 3 headlines and 2 CTA options by EOD.
Ike: demo asks for rehearsal: stable model pin + fallback to quantized variant. snippet I'll use: `MODEL=redwood-2b && ./demo --model $MODEL --fallback redwood-2b-q`
Dina: I'll make presenter cue cards and a slide with fallback GIFs + a visible link to the 90s video.
Rory: follow-up nurture: recording + 1-page checklist + CTA to request a cost audit. Dina will draft.
Maya: marketing will A/B the hero CTA on the page: "Get the checklist" / "See the demo". also social CTAs for LinkedIn + X.
Ike: uploading demo notebook + clips to drive now. link when ready.
Dina: final checklist before tech check: 1) demo artifacts in drive 2) host cue cards 3) fallback video uploaded 4) landing copy draft
Rory: great. next sync at tech check. :rocket:
